body:
Blackstone has launched Blackstone Private Markets Fund (BXPM), a perpetual investment strategy designed to give eligible non-U.S. investors access to private equity, infrastructure, real estate, and private credit through a single allocation. The launch represents Blackstone’s first multi-strategy product introduced through its recently established Blackstone Portfolio Solutions business and builds on the firm’s $324 billion Private Wealth platform.

BXPM is intended to simplify access to Blackstone’s private markets capabilities by combining exposure to four major alternative asset classes within one portfolio.

The fund provides a way for eligible investors to access multiple Blackstone investment strategies without establishing separate allocations to individual funds covering each asset class.

The launch also marks the first time eligible non-U.S. investors will have access to Blackstone’s institutional-quality perpetual investment funds through a single solution.

The fund’s underlying investment opportunities draw on Blackstone’s established global investment businesses.

Its private equity exposure has access to Blackstone’s $364 billion private equity platform, which includes corporate private equity, tactical opportunities, growth investing, life sciences, and secondaries.

The fund can also access Blackstone’s $90 billion infrastructure business, which invests across energy, transportation, digital infrastructure, and other essential assets.

Its real estate exposure draws on Blackstone’s $314 billion real estate platform, which invests in commercial properties and other real estate assets across global markets.

The fund’s fourth component is private credit, supported by Blackstone’s $469 billion credit and insurance business, which operates across global credit markets.

These figures represent the scale of Blackstone’s broader investment businesses, not the amount of capital raised by BXPM. The firm did not disclose BXPM’s initial assets under management.

BXPM is structured as a perpetual strategy, allowing it to provide ongoing exposure to private markets through an investment framework that differs from traditional closed-end private equity funds.

Blackstone intends to use its investment capabilities across the four asset classes to construct a portfolio combining different types of private market investments.

The company describes the strategy as an intentionally constructed allocation rather than simply a collection of separate fund exposures.

For investors, the product is designed to provide broad access to private markets through a single investment decision and a unified portfolio structure.

The launch is part of Blackstone’s broader effort to expand its private wealth business and make alternative investment products available to additional eligible investors.

The firm’s Private Wealth platform has developed over nearly 25 years, distributing private markets investment products through financial advisors, wealth management institutions, and other intermediaries.

BXPM is the first multi-strategy solution introduced under Blackstone Portfolio Solutions, a business announced earlier in 2026.

The initiative is led by Rashmi Madan, Global Head of Portfolio Solutions and CEO of BXPM, who oversees the new fund’s strategy.

Joan Solotar, Blackstone’s Global Head of Private Wealth, leads the firm’s broader efforts to expand access to private market investment products among eligible investors.

Blackstone manages more than $1.3 trillion in assets across real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries, and hedge funds.

BXPM is intended for eligible non-U.S. investors. Its launch announcement is not directed at U.S. persons, and the fund may not generally be offered or sold in the United States or to U.S. persons except under applicable securities-law exemptions.

“Blackstone has been a leader in broadening access to private markets for more than two decades. Today marks a step in that journey: BXPM is the first strategy that gives eligible investors access to Blackstone in a single, simple allocation.”

Joan Solotar, Global Head Of Private Wealth At Blackstone

“We have thoughtfully designed BXPM to enable investors to access private equity, infrastructure, real estate and private credit in a single intentionally constructed portfolio – essentially, it’s private markets simplified by Blackstone.”
